title: GitHub Public Events
description: Fetches the latest public events from the GitHub Events API. Returns up to 30 recent events including pushes, pull requests, issues, and more. No authentication required (60 req/hr rate limit).
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# GitHub Public Events API (unauthenticated: 60 req/hr)
headers = {'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json', 'User-Agent': 'SpeakesQuery-Ingest'}
response = requests.get('https://api.github.com/events', headers=headers, timeout=30)
response.raise_for_status()
events = response.json()

rows = []
for event in events:
    rows.append({
        'event_id': event.get('id', ''),
        'type': event.get('type', ''),
        'actor': event.get('actor', {}).get('login', ''),
        'repo': event.get('repo', {}).get('name', ''),
        'created_at': event.get('created_at', ''),
        'public': event.get('public', True),
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# Parse GitHub ISO timestamps to epoch
if not df.empty and 'created_at' in df.columns:
    df['_epoch'] = pd.to_datetime(df['created_at']).astype('int64') // 10**9

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
